text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahhh. The weather is so nice and warm today…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So… toasty…

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: …san Black! Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: So this is where you were! Please get ready!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Uh, for what?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: What do mean "for what"?! Pull yourself together! We're right in the middle of a music festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We are?!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Look, it's your turn to go on stage! Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I-I rushed out on the stage, but n-n-now what should I do?!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Next up is the up-and-coming singing sensation, Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Wh-what an incredible audience! I can practically feel the heat of their cheering!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (And look at all those smiles.. They're all looking at me with shining eyes!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't let them down… There's only one thing I can do here…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Here I go, everyone! I hope you'll enjoy… "Umapyoi Legend"!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Was that… a dream? Phew! That had me going for a second!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe, did you have a nice dream, Kita? You're smiling.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It was the nicest dream ever! Everyone looking at me had such big smiles!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's kinda hard to explain, but I feel like it helped me grow somehow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From that day on, Kitasan Black's running seems to be more refined.
